CHAPTER.VERS: God has made himself known in Judah,his name is great in Israel.
His tent is in Salem,his dwelling in Zion.
There he broke the lightning arrows,shield, sword, and weapons of war. (Selah)
Terrible is your splendouron the everlasting mountains.
Despoiled were the stout of heart;in the sleep into which they had fallen,none of the warriorscould lift a hand.
At your rebuke, God of Jacob,sank chariot and horse to sleep.
Awful are you: who can standbefore you, when once you are angry?
The judgment you gave from heavenfrightened the earth into silence,
when God arose to judgmentto save the oppressed of the earth. (Selah)
The fiercest shall praise you,to you shall the remnant hold festival.
Vow and pay to your God,and let all who are round him bring presents.
He lops off the courage of princes,and with terror fills kings of the earth.
